tool_input.command:
bq query --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT --use_legacy_sql=false --nouse_cache \
"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.derived55c41b\` AS
SELECT a.row_id AS row_id, ROUND(a.a_val + b.b_val, 6) AS col_sum
FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.rawa55c41b\` a

USING (row_id)" 2>&1 | tail -10
